summary: Defines a YANG data model for managing network interfaces, including both configuration and state data such as status and counters. It is meant as a generic base that interface-type-specific models can extend. It was replaced by RFC 8343.

eli5.summary: Every network plug on a device needs a standard list of settings and meters. This document is the standard form for describing them so tools can read and change them. It was later replaced by a newer form.

questions: how to configure interfaces with netconf
